about: File types the system's default app would run instead of showing, by extension (lower case, no dot). One list for the app (attachments: components/conversation/elements/attachment-open.ts) and the shell (src-tauri/src/opening.rs), which never hands these to the default app. launches: apps, installers, bundles, compiled scripts, shortcuts and links that start something, disk images that mount. scripts: source text that runs when launched; the app's reader shows it instead.
